title: Session S5 combined: (W1) validated SAT pipeline with certified exact minima for sorting/merging/median comparator networks + SB2-median unsoundness finding; (W2) proven-optimal and improved k-selection networks via SAT + evolutionary search
problem: Two concurrent S5 workstreams on one mission. W1: decide existence of a network with <= T comparators satisfying sort / merge(m,n) / median properties; certify minima by UNSAT at T-1 and SAT at T. W2: minimal-size networks placing the k smallest of n inputs on wires 0..k-1 (SEL(n,k)); no published proven optima or best-known table known for this property.
hypothesis: W1: a direct 0-1-principle slot encoding with total channel semantics and property-aware symmetry breaking reproduces literature-proven s(n) and yields certifiable variant minima within single-machine reach. W2: hybrid evolution with error-guided remove-and-repair beats derived upper bounds at mid n, and a slot-model SAT decision proves exact small-n SEL values.
baseline: Plain sorters: proven sizes n<=12 (Harder arXiv:2012.04400 v3, Dec 2020, Isabelle-verified checker; Codish et al. arXiv:1405.5754, 2014); living best-known table Dobbelaere (updated Nov 2025); smallest open case s(13) in [43/44,45]. Variants: Batcher odd-even merges as constructive upper bounds; med(5)=7 folklore-known; median records from Dobbelaere/SorterHunter (fetched 2026-08-26).
proposed_improvement: W1: open DIMACS encoder (sat_net.py) with total simulation semantics (partial variant shown UNSOUND), per-property soundness analysis of symmetry breakers (SB2 proven unsound for designated-output properties), certified exact values M(2,2)=3, M(2,3)=5, M(3,3)=6, M(2,4)=6, med(5)=7, validated reproduction of s(4..6), honest scaling limits. W2: ES with (error,size) lexicographic fitness + crossover between Pareto-record seeds; exact SEL ladder at small n.

novelty_notes: Audit: research/literature/S5-novelty.md sections A-D (accessed 2026-08-26). Plain-s(n) frontier fully occupied by prior work; we claim no new bound there and document compute-scale reasons. W1 variant values are likely classical (med(5)=7 folklore-corroborated; M(m,n) small values probably derivable) - shipped as certificates not novelty claims; genuinely new artifacts = the validated encoder, the SB2 unsoundness finding, and per-value certificate chains. W2: no prior proven-optimal or best-known tables found for general-k SEL(n,k); adjacent art exists (median networks, SorterHunter records).
